I never went to school, but I know beans from my mother and from doing it myself. Beans do not need shop fertilizer — they are not like maize. This plot is not mine, it is borrowed, so I will not put money into fertilizer or chemicals. I have my own seed from last year, and I will work it with my own hands. I do not have cash to pay workers.
